show.description:
Armaan Razdan, once a brilliant young man with a promising future, walks out of jail after spending seven long years behind bars for a crime he never committed. On the very day of his release, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister secretly visits him in prison—revealing that Armaan is no ordinary ex-convict. Known in the shadows as Sikandar, Armaan is the invisible force controlling powerful politicians, corporations, and the business world from behind bars. His only reason for surrendering his freedom years ago was love.

Seven years earlier, Armaan took the blame for a theft to save his girlfriend Sonal, believing her to be the woman who once saved his life. Now free, Armaan dreams of finally proposing to her and starting the life he sacrificed everything for. But fate deals him a brutal blow—Sonal, now an ambitious architect climbing the elite ladder, rejects him publicly, humiliates him for being “just a criminal,” and throws money at his face to erase their past.

Broken but composed, Armaan walks away—only to stumble into another storm.

At a bakery, he witnesses Rhea Suri, a powerful but dignified CEO and single mother, being brutally threatened by her ex-lover Rajveer, who tries to force her into marriage and seize her company. When Rajveer attacks her daughter Ishika, the child instinctively clings to Armaan, calling him her father. Though shocked, Armaan protects them. Later, when Rajveer releases fake nude photos and defamatory news to destroy Rhea’s reputation, Armaan erases everything with a single phone call—without revealing who he really is.
